National Tell a Joke Day is an unofficial holiday celebrated each year on August l6th in the United States and by humor lovers in other countries as well. The purpose of the day is simple and lighthearted: to encourage everyone to share jokes and laughter with friends, family, coworkers, and even strangers.
How is it observed?
• People tell their favorite jokes, puns, or funny stories.
• Some workplaces, schools, and social media accounts organize joke-telling contests or share jokes throughout the day.
• Comedians and comedy clubs may mark the day with specials or themed events.
Why is it celebrated?
• Laughter benefits health and brings people together.
• Jokes are a classic way to break the ice, ease tension, and brighten someone's day.
